empty.title: No categories yet

deleteDialog.description: The category "{name}" will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

form.iconHint: Optional icon name such as smartphone or tv.
form.activeHint: When off, the category is hidden from the site.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.body: Add your first product to show it in the store.

noResults.title: No results
noResults.body: Try different search words or remove some filters.

deleteDialog.title: Delete product?
deleteDialog.description: The product "{name}" and its specifications will be deleted permanently. To only remove it from the store, use "Hide" instead. This cannot be undone.

deleteErrors.delete_failed: Could not delete the product. Try again.

form.nameEnHint: Optional. Used to suggest the slug.
form.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, digits and dashes only. It appears in the product page URL, so avoid changing it later.
form.newBrandHint: Type a name to add a brand that is not in the list (takes priority over the list).
form.priceHint: The regular price. Promotions are added later from the Offers section.

specs.title: Specifications
specs.hint: Shown on the product page and used to compare products. Pick the spec type from the list so it lines up with other products.

form.activeHint: When off, the product is hidden from the site.
form.featuredHint: Can be shown in the featured products section on the homepage.
form.bestsellerHint: Shown in the best sellers section.
form.newOverrideHint: Automatic: the product counts as new based on when it was added.
form.sortOrderHint: A lower number appears earlier. Default is 0.
form.aliasesHint: Alternative names or common misspellings, one per line or comma-separated. Example: iphone, ايفون.

errors.invalid_slug: Use lowercase English letters, digits and dashes only.
errors.slug_taken: This slug is already used by another product.
errors.invalid_price: Enter a valid price of at least 0.
errors.invalid_spec: Make sure each specification has a name and a reasonable length.
errors.duplicate_spec: The same specification type cannot be used twice.
errors.needs_image: Add a primary image to the product first, then show it.

form.saveFailed: Could not save the product. Try again.
form.newImagesNote: The product is saved hidden. After saving you will land on the edit page to add images, and then you can show it to visitors.
form.activeNewHint: You can show the product once it has an image.

toggleErrors.needs_image: Add a primary image to the product first (from its edit page), then show it.
toggleErrors.failed: Could not change the product's visibility. Try again.

images.title: Images
images.hint: The primary image appears in lists and when sharing. You can add up to {max} images.
images.drop: Drag images here or click to choose
images.limitReached: You reached the maximum number of images
images.formats: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF — compressed automatically before upload
images.empty: No images yet. Add a primary image so the product can be shown.

deleteDialog.title: Delete image?
deleteDialog.description: The image will be deleted permanently. If it is the primary image, the first remaining image becomes primary.

errors.uploadFailed: "{name}": the image could not be uploaded.
errors.limit: A product cannot have more than {max} images.
errors.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Try again.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.loadError: Could not load the store settings.

logo.title: Store logo
logo.hint: Shown at the top of the site. A square or horizontal logo with a transparent background works best (PNG or WebP).

deleteDialog.title: Delete logo?
deleteDialog.description: The current logo will be removed from the site.

errors.type: Unsupported file type. Use JPG, PNG or WebP.
errors.uploadFailed: Could not upload the logo. Try again.
errors.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Try again.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.hint: Mark a day closed or set opening and closing times. You can add a second period (for example after a lunch break). If you close after midnight, enter the time as is (such as 02:00).

form.name: Store name
form.currencyHint: Changing the currency does not convert product prices.
form.timezoneHint: Used for the "Open now / Closed" indicator. Example: Asia/Hebron.
form.instagramHint: A full link starting with https://instagram.com/
form.facebookHint: A full link starting with https://facebook.com/
form.seoTitleHint: Up to 70 characters. Shown in search results and the browser tab.
form.seoDescriptionHint: Up to 160 characters. Shown under the title in search results.

errors.invalid_hours: Check the working hours: each period needs different opening and closing times.

form.saveFailed: Could not save the settings. Try again.

appearance.title: Store appearance
appearance.intro: Pick a ready-made preset, then adjust colors, font and corners as you like. The preview updates live.
appearance.presetHint: Changing the preset resets colors, font and corners to the preset's values.
appearance.contrastInfo: Text contrast against the background: {ratio}:1 (at least 4.5 required).

errors.low_contrast_text: The text is hard to read on the background. Pick a darker or lighter color.
errors.low_contrast_primary: The primary color is too close to the background and will not stand out.

appearance.saveFailed: Could not save the appearance. Try again.
